corrections.detail: The first typed IR represented the known-good control as if semantic_acceptance were established. The corrected representation now encodes raw_response_integrity as established and semantic_acceptance as not_established.
The initial T3 expectation was loosened after observing the mismatch. The corrected experiment restores a single frozen T3 outcome: not_applicable.
The first pass stored evidence_refs but did not require deterministic resolution. The corrected representation requires evidence_id linkage and resolution of assertion evidence_refs.
The corrected checker returns internally consistent result/applicability pairs and emits traces derived from the checker output.

conclusion: A minimal typed proposition/evidence representation carrying property, epistemic status, evidence scope, and evidence linkage is sufficient to evaluate the frozen invariant without natural-language interpretation.
limitations: This still does not establish semantic typing acquisition/trust.
This still does not change production observation contracts.
